Weslock 2175-2100, Antique Brass Single Cylinder Colonial Handleset

With a solid brass exterior, the Single Cylinder Colonial Handleset features a textured antique brass finish. It has just enough beautiful details to make it a point of interest for your door while adding an early American style to your home. It comes with your choice of inside handle style. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Easy to install, it will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Single Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from the exterior and by a thumbturn from the interior while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Colonial Double Cylinder Handleset
Colonial Dummy Handleset
Colonial Dual Keyed Single Cylinder Handleset

This classically designed handleset is from the Weslock Traditionale Collection which features solid brass construction and lifetime mechanical and finish warranties.

Features of the Weslock Single Cylinder Colonial Entrance Set:

  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 Grade 2 lock standards.
  • Solid brass exterior.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers that prevent sawing.
  • Removable knobs prevents scratching during installation.
  • Fits doors prepared with standard 2-1/8" top, 2-1/8" bottom cross holes, and 1" edge hole.
  • 5-1/2" minimum center to center cross hole spacing
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Traditionale Collections Single Cylinder Colonial Handleset:

  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Exterior Handle Length: 18"
  • Exterior Handle Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2" with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The finish for the inside knob you choose will be Antique Brass to match the handleset.
